title: Complaint findings and outcome
purpose: Record a complaint's findings and actions, its corrective action reference, and when and how the outcome was communicated.
summary: Keep the complaint record up to date: what was found and done, the corrective action number from the laboratory's quality system, and how the outcome was communicated.

tasks.title: Record findings and actions
steps: Write what was found and done in [[Findings and actions]] and select [[Save record]].

tasks.title: Record the corrective action
steps: Type its number in the laboratory's quality system in [[Corrective action reference]] and select [[Save record]].

tasks.title: Record how the outcome was communicated
steps: Set [[Outcome communicated on]] and describe the way in [[How it was communicated]], then select [[Save record]].

good_to_know: Only the assignee or a supervisor can change the record. You can save as often as needed until the review is done.
The application stores the corrective action number only. The action itself lives in the laboratory's own quality system.
Save is refused unless at least one detail changed.
After a supervisor reviews the complaint, the record can no longer change.

sections.title: Fields and actions
paragraphs: Opens from the Complaint section of the ticket page, as a dialog or a full page. Every field is optional, and the form starts with what is recorded. The form remembers the version of the ticket you opened; if it changed since, saving is refused and you reload. A ticket that is not a complaint answers Not found.

items.label: Findings and actions
items.description: Optional. What the investigation found and what was done.

items.label: Corrective action reference
items.description: Optional, up to 120 characters. Its number in the laboratory's quality system.

items.label: Outcome communicated on
items.description: Optional date the outcome was communicated to the complainant.

items.label: How it was communicated
items.description: Optional, up to 120 characters, for example phone or letter.

items.label: Save record
items.description: Saves and confirms Complaint record saved. Adds a timeline event and an audit event with the before and after values.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the ticket without changing anything.

items.label: Who may record
items.description: The ticket's assignee, or a supervisor (including the admin role).

items.label: Order of work
items.description: The findings can be saved before the investigation decision. The independent review needs the decision first.

items.label: Refusals
items.description: Saving with nothing changed ("Change at least one detail before saving."), and a record whose complaint was already reviewed ("This complaint has been reviewed; its record no longer changes.").
